vocabulary.example: I get up at six every day.
I take a shower every morning.
Reading before bed is a good habit.
vocabulary.example_ko: 자기 전에 책 읽는 것은 좋은 습관이에요.

vocabulary.example: I hardly ever eat fast food.

grammar.explanation_en: Present simple describes routines and habits. Remember to add '-s' or '-es' for he/she/it: 'She commutes by bus', 'He gets up early'. Frequency adverbs (usually, hardly ever) go before the main verb but after 'be': 'I usually walk' vs 'I am usually tired'.
grammar.explanation_ko: 현재시제는 루틴과 습관을 나타냅니다. he/she/it에는 '-s' 또는 '-es'를 붙이는 걸 잊지 마세요: 'She commutes by bus', 'He gets up early'. 빈도 부사(usually, hardly ever)는 일반동사 앞, be동사 뒤에 옵니다: 'I usually walk' 대 'I am usually tired'.

examples.en: He usually takes a shower at night.
My father commutes by car every day.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: I get up at six, take a shower, and eat breakfast quickly.
dialogue.line_ko: 여섯 시에 일어나서 샤워하고 아침을 빨리 먹어요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: How do you commute to work?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: I usually take the subway, but I hardly ever drive.
dialogue.line_ko: 보통 지하철을 타요, 운전은 거의 안 해요.

reading.title: A Healthy Habit
reading.text: My grandmother has a simple but healthy routine. She gets up at five every morning and takes a short walk. She usually eats a light breakfast and hardly ever eats late at night. She says these habits keep her healthy and full of energy.
reading.text_ko: 제 할머니는 단순하지만 건강한 루틴을 가지고 계세요. 매일 아침 다섯 시에 일어나 짧게 산책하세요. 보통 가벼운 아침을 드시고 밤늦게는 거의 드시지 않아요. 이런 습관들이 건강하고 활기차게 지낼 수 있게 해준다고 하세요.

explanation.en: The text says 'She gets up at five every morning.'
The text says 'she usually eats a light breakfast.'
The text says 'hardly ever eats late at night.'
explanation.ko: 본문에 'hardly ever eats late at night'이라고 나옵니다.
